name: Veil-ian #11
description: A veiled figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Beaded cap. Aperture: Woven band. Ornament: Nested chevrons. Palette: Bone + lilac. Hem: Layered. Its hem is shared with one other in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
